title: MOTION
summary: Motion is the change in position of an object with time. An object is said to be in motion when its position changes relative to its surroundings. Distance is the total path length travelled by an object. Displacement is the shortest distance between the initial and final position of an object. Speed is the distance travelled by an object per unit time. Velocity is the displacement of an object per unit time. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with time.
